recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a group of performers rendered in a vibrant magenta duotone against a solid black void, topped with a mix of psychedelic script and geometric sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Magenta figures anchored to the bottom edge against a deep black background
Horizontal typographic stack centered in the upper half
Contrast between organic, textured photographic silhouettes and clean, sharp vector text
Tri-color palette of black, magenta, and white with a red-to-white gradient accent
coreInvariants: Solid black background with zero detail in the shadows
Tight, overlapping letterforms in the secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the bottom 50% of the frame, arranged horizontally with varying heights.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized script logo in the upper right quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright script logo, drop to the white sans-serif title, and settle on the textured magenta figures below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper left and center creates a dramatic, stage-lit atmosphere.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta (Mid-tones and highlights of the subjects)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with no gray tones; saturation is locked to the magenta and red channels.

letterConstructionRules: Script: Heavy weight, high-contrast strokes, extreme slant, and interlocking descenders.
Sans: Low x-height, tight tracking, and circular 'o' and 'e' forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' and 't' in the subtitle feature elongated tails that create a rhythmic baseline.
The script logo uses a horizontal split-tone effect (red top, white bottom).
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, expressive script with a rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tight-tracking, geometric lowercase aesthetic of the subtitle.
Captures the 70s-era heavy script weight and fluid connections.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast image of four female soul singers on a stage, rendered as a magenta duotone against a solid black background. The lighting should be harsh, blowing out highlights and leaving shadows completely black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold script logo in the upper right with a red-on-white horizontal split. Below it, center a lowercase geometric sans-serif title in solid white with extremely tight letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the figures strictly magenta and black?
Is the subtitle text lowercase and touching?
Does the script logo have a horizontal color split?

adjustableVariables: Magenta hue (can shift toward purple or pink)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers
Unique brand logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones exist in the background.
Check that the magenta doesn't bleed into the white text.
Verify the script font feels heavy and 1970s-inspired.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-Contrast Duotone [Color] + Geometric Sans [Lowercase] + Heavy Script [Split-Tone]
